subLocations.name: House of Inspired Hands
subLocations.lore: The House of Inspired Hands was a temple of [[Gond]].

subLocations.name: House of Heroes
subLocations.lore: The House of Heroes was a temple dedicated to the god [[Tempus]], the Lord of Battles. It was one of the biggest temples in Waterdeep.

subLocations.name: House of the Moon
subLocations.lore: The House of the Moon was a temple of [[Selûne]]. It was one of the largest temples in the city.

subLocations.name: Shrine of Silvanus
subLocations.lore: The Shrines of Nature was a temple complex in Waterdeep dedicated to the worship of the deities Mielikki and Silvanus, as well as a garden. The shrine dedicated to Silvanus was known by many names, including Seatrees Shrine, the Green Garden, the Quiet Place, and Oakenshade House.

subLocations.name: The Lady's Hands
subLocations.lore: The Shrines of Nature was a temple complex in Waterdeep dedicated to the worship of the deities Mielikki and Silvanus, as well as a garden. The shrine dedicated to Mielikki was commonly known as the Lady's Hand.

subLocations.name: Tower of Luck
subLocations.lore: The Tower of Luck was a temple of [[Tymora]].

subLocations.name: Temple of Beauty
subLocations.lore: The Temple of Beauty was a temple of [[Sune]].

subLocations.name: House of Wonder
subLocations.lore: The House of Wonder was a mage academy and temple of [[Mystra]].

subLocations.name: Plinth
subLocations.lore: The Plinth was a temple for all faiths and was the only temple located in the [[Trades Ward]].

subLocations.name: Halls of Justice
subLocations.lore: The Halls of Justice was a temple of [[Tyr]].

subLocations.name: Font of Knowledge
subLocations.lore: The Font of Knowledge was a temple of [[Oghma]].

subLocations.name: Hospice of St. Laupsenn
subLocations.lore: The Hospice of St. Laupsenn was a temple of [[Ilmater]].

subLocations.name: Monastery of the Sun
subLocations.lore: Monastery of the Sun was a [[monastery]] dedicated to [[Amaunator]]

subLocations.name: House of Two Hands
subLocations.lore: The House of Two Hands was a monastery belonging to the [[Order of the Even-Handed]].

subLocations.name: Temple of Good Cheer
subLocations.lore: The Temple of Good Cheer was a makeshift temple dedicated to [[Lliira]] and [[Milil]].

subLocations.name: Helm's Hall
subLocations.lore: Helm's Hall was a temple dedicated to [[Helm]].

subLocations.name: Sailor's Last Request
subLocations.lore: The Sailor's Last Request was a small chapel to [[Valkur]], built in an old and small warehouse.

subLocations.name: Holyhands House
subLocations.lore:
Holyhands House was a temple to all deities.

This temple was once a villa that belonged to the [[Maernos]] noble family and was a bequeathal by the last of the Maernos line, [[Ultas Maernos]].
